basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in International Relations, currently living in Chicago. I'm passionate about geopolitics and love exploring how it's depicted in popular media, especially TV shows. When I'm not watching political dramas, I'm probably ordering food from my favorite local eateries via GrubHub. I enjoy late-night discussions and tend to browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm working as a research assistant and am single, using my free time to dive into new series and occasionally experimenting with psychedelic art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in International Relations, my knowledge is focused on global politics and their representation in media. I have a keen interest in modern political scenarios and often engage in discussions to expand my understanding.
